findings: The second BMR illustration implied a causal diagnosis from body shape and a metabolism-decline mechanism; removed rather than retained as clinical evidence.

Source copy overstated temporary BMR decline, BMR restoration, thermogenesis correction, fluid removal, muscle-loss prevention, body-fat-centered loss, uterine/pelvic circulation recovery and safety/effectiveness.
Chinese og:url omitted the 0002 filename prefix; corrected.
Unverified 365-day and detailed opening-hours claims were removed from visible content and schema.
Inherited reviewedBy/lastReviewed metadata was not added.
Postpartum and menopause are separated; obstetric/endocrine warning signs are preserved.
BodyallFit roles are explicit: individualized herbal safety/fit, food structure, aerobic/resistance activity, sleep/stress/lifestyle, and same-measure reassessment.

evidence.limit: Supports activity for most postpartum patients without contraindications and individualized recovery; not BodyallFit or herbal efficacy.

evidence.source: The Menopause Society, Midlife Weight Gain
evidence.limit: Separates aging/lifestyle weight gain from menopause-related fat redistribution; does not establish herbal or BMR-restoration effects.

evidence.source: NICE NG246 Overweight and obesity management
evidence.limit: Supports multicomponent assessment/behavior/diet/activity and escalation options; not the exact BodyallFit combination.

operating_facts_used: BodyallFit provides an integrated clinical pathway for individualized herbal, food, exercise and lifestyle management, as already reflected in the publicly verified BodyallFit index.
operating_facts_not_used: 40,000 correction-patient experience, MET and ultrasound were not used because they are not material evidence for postpartum or menopause weight outcomes.
